description: Answers 'backtest my StockCharts scan on real history.' Give a scan and a start date; optionally end, symbols (e.g. a ChartList) to restrict the universe, top_n (default 50) and rebalance (D/W/M/Q, default W). Each rebalance holds the stocks that pass the scan, equally weighted up to top_n, at 10 bps costs, on point-in-time US stocks since 2000 with delisted names included. Returns the translation plus the same stats, benchmark and equity curve as run_backtest. Costs one backtest; free keys cover the last 12 months.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: backtest_stockcharts_scan
title: Backtest a StockCharts scan
